variables.description: Managed execution pool. Storage access is granted per-run by assuming an IAM role via OIDC; there are no volume mounts on managed execution.

image.title: Image
image.description: Official Prefect image only. Managed execution cannot run custom images.

pip_packages.title: Pip Packages
pip_packages.description: Installed via pip at runtime, before any pull steps.

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: DATA_BUCKET / DATA_PREFIX select the storage location for the run. An override replaces this whole object rather than merging into it, so DATA_BUCKET is required: a partial override that forgets it is rejected at run creation instead of failing mid-flow.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds before the run is forcibly crashed. Hard max 86400 (24h).

federated_identity.title: Federated Identity
federated_identity.description: Assume an IAM role via STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity and inject short-lived credentials. The role's policy is what actually maps this run to a bucket.
